reason: The patch calls datasource.applyTemplateVariables(query, request.scopedVars, request.filters) in public/app/plugins/datasource/loki/querySplitting.ts:299 and public/app/plugins/datasource/loki/shardQuerySplitting.ts:52 (which delegates to runSplitQuery at shardQuerySplitting.ts:163), while keeping scopedVars and filters on subRequest into LokiDatasource.runQuery -> super.query (datasource.ts:349-351), where packages/grafana-runtime/src/utils/DataSourceWithBackend.ts:185 calls applyTemplateVariables again. Because applyTemplateVariables invokes addAdHocFilters (datasource.ts:1127) and addFilterAsLabelFilter (modifyQuery.ts:510) appends label filter clauses without deduplication, filters and template variables are applied twice on the time-split path and three times on the shard path, duplicating filters in the generated LogQL.
